message.index_prescript.prescript.0: Eat three loaves of bread before the sun sets.
message.index_prescript.prescript.1: Defeat the first zombie you meet with your bare hands.
message.index_prescript.prescript.2: Do not sleep in a bed tonight.
message.index_prescript.prescript.3: Hand a single flower to the person nearest to you.
message.index_prescript.prescript.4: Place exactly seven torches in the next cave.
message.index_prescript.prescript.5: Walk 100 blocks north, then look up at the sky.
message.index_prescript.prescript.6: Leave the next iron ore you find untouched.
message.index_prescript.prescript.7: Do not chat until the sun rises.
message.index_prescript.prescript.9: Put the item in your hand into a chest and forget it.
